data.name: Saiteja
data.gender_notes: Saiteja is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saiteja is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Sa (Goddess of Fortune) and Teja (Power). This name represents the goddess of fortune and prosperity, who is believed to bestow her blessings upon her devotees. The name Saiteja carries the meaning “Goddess of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Telugu, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Saiteja usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saiteja is a divine name that symbolizes the power of the goddess of fortune and her blessings.
data.etymology: Saiteja belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saiteja total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Saiteja, being a derivative of this deity's name, carries the same auspicious significance in Hindu culture. This name is popular among Hindus, particularly those who revere Lakshmi as the deity of wealth and abundance.
